title: Floating cheeseburger
content: I don't know how to explain how or why this dream has always been so scary to me but it's one of my least favorite. I struggled with night terrors everyday until I was 12. This one in particular I would "wake up" from a night terror and then I as I'm calming down I would notice a floating perfect cheeseburger in the corner of my room. It would just float and spin for a minute or so and the whole room would expand to the size of a bunker and the cheeseburger would be really far away and my stomach would drop and it was terrifying. Why, I do not know.
